messages.text: merged with critical caveats: The requested controlled application matrix remains unproven. The host was shared and the measured generated index set had 190 statements. The adapter attempted 195 statements, with the five differences unidentified. The base arm was a primary-key-only snapshot, not a demonstrated run of base revision 13d7c1e74. The measured clients were SQL sessions, not application clients. The original project-read slowdown remains unattributed. Unchanged query plans do not exclude cache, I/O, contention or application effects. The report provides summarized plans without raw EXPLAIN ANALYZE captures. The complete index list with bytes per index is absent. The size table contains only eight named indexes in rounded MB. The attach probe calls createTables without a full transactor attach. Its second getDBClient call shares the existing pool for the URL. The second argument is a database name, so it does not configure connect_timeout. The probe therefore does not prove an independent connection or full transactor timeout acceptance. http://huly.lan/workbench/hulyaccessevaluation/tracker/JH-902544
